messages:
mari: Hey team — can someone run onboarding benchmarks for starlite-7b-q (q4_0) in staging? Need seq=2048, batches 1/4/8, 100k tokens per config, KV cache warm vs cold, compare against baseline v1.12. Target: p95 < 250ms for batch=1 and throughput >= 350 tok/s. Ping @aj @kevin.

aj: On it. I'll queue the job on stg-gpu2 (A100-40GB). ETA ~45m. I'll capture p50/p95, throughput, GPU mem, and cost estimate.

kevin: I'll pin 2 nodes and disable autoscale for the window. Tell me when you start so I can confirm capacity.

sasha: Please include kernel traces (`--trace kernels`) and a run with `--quant-profile q4_0-fast` vs `q4_0` so we can see tradeoffs. Also log KV cache hit rate.

dina: Add a burst test too: 200 qps for 5m to exercise tail. If it kills the queue, let me know and I'll revert.

benchbot: Run queued: id=r-20260304-01, model=starlite-7b-q, seq=2048, batches=[1,4,8], tokens=100000, cache=[warm,cold], traces=enabled.

aj: Job started on stg-gpu2. Running warm cache batch=1 first.

benchbot: r-20260304-01: warm cache batch=1 finished. p50=44ms, p95=112ms, throughput=430 tok/s, GPU mem=12.2GB, cost_est= $0.32 per 1k tokens. Kernel breakdown: flash_attn 24%, matmul 18%, kv_copy 9%, other 49%.

aj: Warm batch=4 done. p50=90ms, p95=185ms, throughput=1600 tok/s, GPU mem=14.8GB, cost_est=$0.29 per 1k.

aj: Warm batch=8 done. p50=170ms, p95=340ms, throughput=2800 tok/s, GPU mem=18.6GB, cost_est=$0.27 per 1k. Note: p95 for batch=8 exceeds SLO for single-request latency but throughput is good for batch use cases.

benchbot: Cold cache runs starting (full KV cold).

benchbot: r-20260304-01: cold cache batch=1 finished. p50=96ms, p95=320ms, throughput=210 tok/s, GPU mem=12.1GB. Cold start penalty ~+200ms p95.

aj: Burst test (200 qps for 5m) completed: observed tail spikes up to 420ms during sustained 200qps; queueing increased latency for singletons when batch window grew. Suggest limiting batch window to 8ms under heavy qps.

sasha: Kernel traces show flash_attn hot but kv_copy and kv_cache_mgmt account for a larger-than-expected slice (~12%). There's a small memcpy hotspot in the runloop at 2.3% — likely staging driver/glibc alignment.

kevin: Infra notes: stg-gpu2 nodes handled memory fine, no OOM. I left autoscale off until 18:30 UTC.

mari: Quick comparison vs baseline v1.12 (same HW): v1.12 warm p95 batch=1 was 130ms, throughput 390 tok/s. So starlite-7b-q is slightly faster on warm p95 (112ms) and ~10% better throughput. Cold starts are worse than baseline by ~120ms.

aj: TL;DR: Pass for warm-serving workloads. Need mitigation for cold-start tail (KV prefetch or light-weight warmed container). Also consider keeping a small warm pool for low-latency tier.

mari: Thanks all — this is great. Action items: (1) eng-runtime to add warm-pool recommendation to onboarding doc, (2) runtime to test KV prefetch patch (sasha), (3) product to decide if we ship as default or flag as batch-optimized. I'll open a small PR to model-catalog with these numbers and add the perf notes.

benchbot: r-20260304-01: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/starlite-7b-q/r-20260304-01/summary.json

mari: Published results and PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/472 — tagging @product for rollout decision. :tada:

dina: Nice work everyone. If we want to target <200ms p95 cold, we should reserve a tiny warm pool for the next release and re-run.

mari: Agreed. I'll loop product and ops. Closing thread unless anyone needs follow-ups.

kevin: noted. thanks.

aj: Thanks — will follow up with KV prefetch experiment next week.
